name: stripe
summary: Take card payments with Stripe instead of the native stub.

env.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
env.comment: Your Stripe secret key (Dashboard, Developers, API keys)

env.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.comment: The signing secret of the webhook endpoint below

env.name: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
env.comment: Your Stripe publishable key, which the storefront's payment form uses

next: Add a webhook endpoint in the Stripe dashboard at https://<your API host>/api/webhooks/stripe and copy its signing secret into STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
For local development, stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3001/api/webhooks/stripe prints a signing secret to use instead.
